_comment: Phase 9E - Route Recommendation Engine configuration. The engine consumes Phase 9D road scores (data/processed/phase9d_road_scores.csv) and never modifies them. All candidate routes below are DETERMINISTIC MOCK/TEST routes using the fictional MOCK-ROAD-* IDs from Phase 9D. They describe NO real roads/routes/distances/travel times. Any distance_km / travel_time_minutes present are explicit FICTIONAL mock values used only to exercise distance-weighted logic. No secrets stored.

scoring._comment: Distance-weighted averaging is used ONLY when every segment of a route carries an explicit non-negative distance_km. Otherwise equal segment weighting is used over the KNOWN segments. UNKNOWN segments never contribute a score; they are counted and reported.

confidence._comment: route_confidence = mean(Phase 9D per-segment confidence over ALL segments) * min(per-segment data-mode factor) * (known_segment_count / total_segment_count), clipped to [0.05, 1.0]. Conservative and explainable: unknown segments, mock mode, and missing data all lower confidence; it is never a precision-heavy fake.

recommendation_statuses._comment: Highest-scoring eligible route (numeric route_score) among the candidate set. Single pick; ties broken by confidence, then known count, then route_id.
Valid route with a numeric route_score that is not the top pick.
Valid route with zero known segments (every segment score UNKNOWN); route_score stays UNKNOWN.
Route is invalid: references a nonexistent road_id, has a duplicate route_id, empty segment list, or invalid segment_order.

routes._comment: MOCK/TEST route. All three segments have known Phase 9D scores; no explicit distances, so equal weighting is used.
MOCK/TEST route. Explicit FICTIONAL mock distances and travel times (NOT real), used to exercise distance-weighted scoring.
MOCK/TEST route. Contains one UNKNOWN-score segment (MOCK-ROAD-07); score computed from known segments only.
MOCK/TEST route. Every segment score is UNKNOWN -> route score UNKNOWN, INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
MOCK/TEST route. References a nonexistent road ID -> INVALID_ROUTE.
MOCK/TEST route with a DUPLICATE route_id (same as ROUTE-A). Duplicate route IDs are rejected as INVALID_ROUTE and excluded from ranking.
